question: What must be prepared before making offerings into the Śiva fire?
premises: The lords of the images are addressed or invoked.
The ritual setup is thus prepared.
The Śiva fire is made ready.
inference: After invoking the lords of the images and preparing accordingly, one prepares the Śiva fire.
uncertainties: The token tvā is morphologically unclear in this context and is interpreted functionally.
plain_english: Having invoked the lords of the images and thus prepared everything, one prepares the Śiva fire.
